title: Value-owned graph edit history and logical-identity document diff are ledgered

needles: graph edit history refuses to undo over an unrecorded edit
graph document diff compares by logical identity, not NodeId
graph edit history refuses a restore that would leave a node unresolved
saved document inspection rebuilds identities for every node kind
saved document inspection refuses identities that name other nodes
saved document inspection rebuilds identities the loader would assign

installed_sdk.rationale: GraphEditHistory and diff_graph_documents are public host APIs over saved-identity documents (v7 written, v6 still read); they hold no pointer into a live graph and the diff is data-only.

needles: graph edit history undoes and redoes by value

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: pulp graph diff reads two bounded saved documents and reports their logical-identity differences; it never loads plugin code or writes files. Its inputs come from pulp graph save --saved-identity, and save, fmt and canonicalize keep an input's identity envelope.

needles: graph diff compares saved documents by logical identity
graph CLI success code and fmt use the C++ spelling
graph save and fmt keep the saved-identity envelope that diff reads
graph CLI file size and readability codes agree across subcommands
A file of exactly the bound is read and judged as a document instead.
graph CLI fmt prints the C++ canonical notation for flow 1 and flow 2

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: The pulp_graph MCP tool exposes operation diff with explicit before and after paths. It runs the matched sibling pulp-cpp graph diff --json (the CLI implementation) without a shell, with a 30 second deadline and a 2 MiB output cap; a comparison that finds differences is a successful result and only a refusal is an MCP error.

live_product_control.rationale: History restores through GraphSerializer on the caller's thread; it adds no runtime operation or executor authority.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability or agent manifest entry is added.
